name_input: M/S SATI EXPORTS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records, company page https://importkey.com/countries/india/sati-exports-india-private-limited — header states "Total Shipments 13547 Records detected", "Trading Partners 31", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | SATI EXPORTS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER | POLISHED GRANITE SLAB CUTTER SLABS 2 CM | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | Latakia, SYRIAN | 68022390 | BOL 1128540". Further rows seen on the same page: 2026-02-28 Chennai Sea -> Gdansk, POLAND, HS 68022390, BOL 1112454; 2026-02-28 Chennai Sea -> Gdansk, POLAND, HS 68022390, BOL 1117599; 2026-02-28 Kamarajar Port INENR1 -> Gdansk, POLAND, HS 68022390, BOL 1143116; 2026-02-28 Mundra Sea INMUN1 -> Aliaga, TURKEY, HS 68022390, BOL 1127668. Second slug https://importkey.com/countries/india/sati-exports-india-pvt-ltd returned 2 rows, e.g. "2024-07-16 | SATI EXPORTS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | SATI EXPORTS INDIA PVT LTD | POLISHED GRANITE MONUMENT (SAMPLES) (EXHIBITION MAROMAC) | CHENNAI SEA, India | ROTTERDAM, ITALY | 68022390 | BOL 2469164". Source counter vs rows actually seen: counter 13547 shipments / 31 partners; only 5 export rows visible on the free page (plus 2 on the second slug) — the counter is a paywalled aggregate, the 5 rows are the verifiable evidence. Top ports listed: CHENNAI SEA INMAA1 821, CHENNAI SEA 621, Gdynia 424, KAMARAJAR PORT INENR1 378, Jebel Ali 291.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split was retrievable: the web_search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both queries, and volza.com returned "fetch_error: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden". Domestic supply therefore not established either way — null, not invented.
note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records, not by website claims: polished granite slabs under HS 68022390 (matching the declared 680223 family) moving from Chennai Sea, Kamarajar Port and Mundra to Syria, Poland and Turkey, latest record 2026-02-28, with B/L numbers 1128540, 1112454, 1117599, 1143116, 1127668. The company is a genuine exporter of granite, not a trader with paper claims. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey reports 13,547 total shipments and 31 trading partners, but only 5 export rows were actually visible on the free page, so the volume figure is a platform aggregate and should not be treated as independently verified. Declared HS codes 680223/680291/680292/680293 are consistent with the observed 68022390 line — no HS correction needed. Domestic (intra-India) supply evidence could not be checked because the search backend was unreachable and Volza blocked the request; recorded as unknown rather than assumed. No rejection grounds: the entity is active and shipping as of 2026-02-28.
